description: AND, OR, NOT, ORDER BY, LIMIT, DISTINCT — sharper answers.

questions.code:
SELECT name
FROM students
ORDER BY gpa DESC
LIMIT 1;
questions.explanation: DESC = highest first; Priya's 3.9 tops the table.

questions.code:
SELECT name
FROM students
WHERE gpa > 3.0
LIMIT 3
ORDER BY gpa;
questions.explanation: LIMIT must come AFTER ORDER BY — the clause order is fixed.
options: LIMIT must come after ORDER BY
